Name: Baits Do Their Jobs
Author: MercuryVN
Description:
[b][size=4]Mod detail[/size]
[/b][size=3]I am tired of my precious bait get wasted by RNG so I made it so that wild bait, targeted bait (made by bait maker) and magnet bait will not be consumed if they failed to catch what they are supposed to catch.
I made this without harmony because I am too afraid to modify game code
I made this initially for my personal use so if you encounter any problem, please let me know

[/size][b][size=4]Feature[/size][/b]
[size=3]Wild bait: If you catch anything other than double fish (including non-fish like trash, algae, etc) while equipping wild bait, it will not be consumed. Can also force wild bait to always catch double fish (excluding legendary fish).
Targeted bait: If you catch anything other than the fish mentioned by the bait (including non-fish) while equipping targeted bait, it will not be consumed. Can also force targeted bait to catch that fish if possible
Magnet bait: If you do not encounter a treasure chest while playing the fishing minigame while equipping magnet bait, it will not be consumed; if a treasure chest appears but you do not catch it, bait will be consumed. Can also force treasure to appear if not fishing during festival.
*** If you fail the fishing minigame, the bait will be consumed ***[/size]

[size=4][b]How to use[/b][/size]
[size=3]Extract and put in the Mods folder[/size]

[size=4][b]Config
[/b][/size][size=3]Run the game with this mod at least once to generate config.json file
All following options are true by default:
[/size][list]
[*][size=3]MagnetBaitEnabled: Enable mod for magnet bait[/size]
[*][size=3]WildBaitEnabled: Enable mod for wild bait[/size]
[*][size=3]TargetedBaitEnabled: Enable mod for targeted bait[/size]
[/list][size=3]All following options are false by default and will only work if the respective bait option above is enabled
[/size][list]
[*][size=3]ForceTreasure: Force treasure to appear when using magnet bait[/size]
[*][size=3]ForceDoubleFish: Force wild bait to catch double fish[/size]
[*][size=3]ForceTargetedFish: Force targeted bait to catch the targeted fish[/size]
[/list][size=3]Compatible with [/size][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098][size=3]Generic Mod Config Menu
[/size]
[/url][b][size=4]Change log
[/size][/b][size=3]0.1: Initial release
0.2: Add options to force baits to actually do their jobs
0.3: Fix compatibility with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/28447]Fish Bonanza[/url] (and hopefully with other content patcher fish mod)[/size]

[size=4][b]Compatibility[/b][/size]
[size=3]Only tested on Windows
Compatible with my other mod [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/22766]Only Fish Consume Bait[/url]
Have not tested if there are other mods conflict
Have not tested in multiplayer, but it should be compatible
[s]Reportedly not compatible with [/s][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/28447][s]Fish Bonanza[/s][/url] => should be fixed in 0.3.0

[size=4][b]Limitation[/b][/size]
[size=3]If you notice that you sometimes get an addtional bait while hooking something up, worry not I make sure that additional bait is not exploitable (probably)[/size]
